market_summary: During the London session, markets display broad consolidation within session value areas. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) are trading below session VWAP and EMA50 baselines, retesting local value area POCs from below without volume confirmation. GBPUSD is attempting to push session highs above VAH but suffers from bearish CVD divergence and lack of RVOL > 2.0 confirmation at key resistance. US100 and BTCUSD remain compressed beneath declining VWAPs and are balancing near key intraday inflection points (US100 at VAL/Session Low, BTCUSD directly at POC) on average-to-low volume. All assets currently lack high-probability directional confluence, warranting a disciplined HOLD across the board.

signals.rationale: Price is trading inside the Value Area (VAL 3884.20 to VAH 3911.53) and remains below POC (3896.98). CVD is BEARISH at -2.08 with a negative slope (-0.02), agreeing with the structural downtrend but diverging from the short-term forming candle bounce. Context is LONDON_SESSION. Price is positioned below VWAP (3902.82) and below downward-sloping EMA50 (3901.22). Candles are consolidating mid-channel between baseline EMA20 (3900.47) and lower ATR band (3884.96). RVOL is 0.965 with standard grey volume bars, lacking yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout confirmation. Price is contained between support at S/R 3887.45 / Session Low 3878.91 and overhead resistance at POC 3896.98 / Session High 3922.99; with price inside the value area and mid-channel, conditions favor a hold.
signals.level_event: rejection of S/R 3887.45 and approach to POC 3896.98

signals.rationale: Price is positioned above VAH (1.32378) and above POC (1.32349). CVD is BEARISH at -2550 despite a positive short-term slope (+1698.13), creating a clear divergence against price trading near session highs. Context is LONDON_SESSION. Price is holding above VWAP (1.32325) and above EMA50 (1.32346). Price is testing the upper ATR band (1.32440), showing an extended condition. RVOL is 1.386 with grey bars, lacking the required yellow RVOL > 2.0 spike to validate an expansion above VAH, signaling high risk of a bull trap. The signal bar printed upper rejection wicks directly against S/R 1.32391 and Session High 1.32431; buying directly into resistance and the upper ATR envelope without volume confirmation is avoided.
signals.level_event: rejection at Session High 1.32431 and S/R 1.32391

signals.rationale: Price is trading inside the Value Area (VAL 28165.06 to VAH 28409.31) and sits below POC (28266.25). CVD is NEUTRAL at -1.78 with a negative slope (-0.53), reflecting lack of aggressive directional momentum. Context is LONDON_SESSION. Price is below declining VWAP (28327.15) and below EMA50 (28285.07). ATR bands show volatility contraction with price lingering in the lower half of the channel near the lower ATR band (28151.00). RVOL is 1.033 with normal grey volume bars; while US100 CFD tick volume rarely prints yellow RVOL > 2.0 spikes, other confluence factors remain absent. Price is hovering just above Session Low / VAL at 28165.06 while held under S/R 28209.17; the setup remains range-bound inside value prior to New York hours.
signals.level_event: acceptance near Session Low 28165.06 below S/R 28209.17

signals.rationale: Price is trading inside the Value Area (VAL 49.748 to VAH 50.470) and remains below POC (50.049). CVD is BEARISH at -113.6 with a negative slope (-32.13), aligning with higher-timeframe weakness but diverging from the immediate forming bar bounce. Context is LONDON_SESSION. Price is below falling VWAP (50.228) and below EMA50 (50.205). The market is moving mid-channel after bouncing from the lower ATR band (49.710). RVOL is 1.55 with grey bars, lacking yellow RVOL > 2.0 volume confirmation for a breakdown or reversal. Price is currently testing immediate resistance at S/R 49.922 after defending Session Low 49.579 and Prev Low 49.688; lacking edge inside the value area, patience is warranted.
signals.level_event: rejection at S/R 49.922 after holding above VAL 49.748

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 67782.90 to VAH 70268.28), oscillating directly at session POC (68676.09). CVD is BEARISH at -0.04 with a flat slope (0.0), indicating balanced passive flow with minimal active participant aggression. Context is LONDON_SESSION. Price remains structurally below VWAP (69429.72) and EMA50 (69840.28). Price is consolidating mid-channel between lower ATR band (68189.32) and EMA20 baseline (68946.22) with narrowing ATR bands. RVOL is low at 0.828 with grey bars, showing no volume climax or breakout interest. Price is held well above Session Low 67549.90 and below overhead resistance at Session High 71433.30 / Prev Low 71031.00; compression directly at the fair value POC mandates a hold.
